audit_items.proof_trace: `add_outflow` (L84) asserts `count_current_outflow(now) + value <= outflow_limit` before any write, keeping the running sum within [0, outflow_limit]; Move aborts on u64 overflow, so the check cannot be bypassed arithmetically. `count_current_outflow` (L164) correctly implements a sliding window of `len` slots using the condition `(len > timestamp_index) || (segment.index >= timestamp_index - len + 1)`, with a short-circuit guard preventing u64 underflow during the early period (`timestamp_index < len`); the circular buffer's slot reuse naturally overwrites expired entries. All callers derive `now` from the Sui blockchain's trusted, monotonically increasing `Clock` object, preventing timestamp manipulation.
